description: This file contains API utility functions for fetching user-related data such as user projects and basic user info via REST endpoints. It includes functions getUserProjects and getUserBasic, which interact with backend services to retrieve user data.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches projects associated with a user from the backend, allowing optional filtering by organization and date range.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves minimal basic info (id and name) for a user by MongoDB ObjectId, handling not found cases gracefully.
